sources.cadence: The GDELT GKG stream and RSS feeds are polled every 5 to 10 minutes, and each article is fetched and parsed directly from the publisher's page. A per-ticker rotation revisits the 300 most active tickers about every 2.5 hours and the rest about every 25 hours.
sources.history_note: The collectors expanded in June 2026, when the GKG bulk collector and the RSS feeds landed together: months before that hold far fewer articles per day, and November 2024 to March 2025 holds fragments only. first_row_at is the earliest article, not the start of dense coverage.
limits: English-language articles only; since 2026-08-26 pages whose title or body is mostly non-Latin script are dropped before enrichment.
Only enriched articles are served: the feed applies a relevance floor (default 4) and requires a verified ticker or a market-wide macro category.
Summaries and per-ticker analysis only; the full article text is never served.
Some publishers are reached only through the per-ticker rotation, so their articles can arrive hours after publication.
created_at is when the article arrived; time_published is GDELT's first-seen time for GKG rows and the publisher's own time for RSS rows.

channels.cadence: Polled every 5 minutes; GDELT publishes a new GKG file every 15 minutes.
RSS feeds polled every 5 to 10 minutes; a per-ticker rotation revisits the 300 most active tickers about every 2.5 hours and the rest about every 25 hours.

sources.cadence: The SEC EDGAR Form 4 feed is polled every 5 minutes during US hours and every 30 minutes off-hours.
sources.history_note: Live collection since May 2026. Filings from August 2025 to May 2026 were replayed from SEC daily indexes in August 2026 without enrichment: they count here and on /api/symbols/{ticker}/insider-trades/, but have no scored article in the news feed. first_row_at is the earliest replayed filing.
limits: Open-market transactions only: non-derivative purchases (code P), sales (S) and dispositions to the issuer (D). Grants, option exercises, tax withholding and derivative-table rows are not collected, so counts run below EDGAR's raw Form 4 total.
The issuer must map to an active symbol in our universe; filings by issuers we do not track are skipped.
One feed row per filing and (transaction code, ownership form) group: a laddered 10b5-1 sale is one event. Per-tranche detail is on /api/symbols/{ticker}/insider-trades/.

sources.cadence: The SEC EDGAR 8-K feed is polled every 5 minutes during US hours and every 30 minutes off-hours.
sources.history_note: Collected since June 2026; there is no 8-K history before that. Until 2026-09-17 filings carrying only items 7.01 or 8.01 (Regulation FD, Other Events — the way debt and convertible offerings are usually filed) were not collected.
limits: The issuer must be an active symbol in our universe.
Only filings carrying at least one surfaced item: 1.01, 1.02, 2.01, 2.02, 2.03, 3.02, 5.02, 5.07, and since 2026-09-17 also 7.01 and 8.01.
The summary is built from the press-release exhibit (EX-99.1) or the cover document; a filing whose manifest lists no readable document is still recorded, header-only.
Tickers on 8-K rows are assigned by the enricher (the liquid issuer a reader follows), not copied from the security that filed.

sources.cadence: Polled by the same EDGAR worker as the 8-K feed, as a second pass each cycle: every 5 minutes during US hours, every 30 minutes off-hours.
sources.history_note: Live since 2026-08-28; filings from 2026-07-28 to 2026-08-28 were backfilled. Nothing before 2026-07-28.
limits: Only 6-K filings a deterministic text classifier reads as an earnings release (results for a period, at least two metric families). Interim and annual reports, dividend and buyback notices, AGM materials, transcripts and KPI updates are logged but not ingested.
The issuer must be an active symbol in our universe.
Every row carries category earnings.

sources.cadence: A standing worker claims new 8-K item 2.02 filings and classified 6-K earnings releases as they arrive; each read is attached to the filing's feed row.
sources.history_note: Reads exist for filings from 2026-07-28 onward. The analyzer only reads filings younger than its age window, so earlier filings will never get one.
limits: 8-K item 2.02 and classified 6-K earnings releases only, and only for tickers in the major-ticker set.
A read is published only when its numbers verify against the filing text; a filing whose numbers cannot be verified is skipped, so not every earnings filing has a read.

sources.cadence: Polled daily from Yahoo Finance (05:30 UTC) for major tickers whose last earnings filing is at least 55 days old.
sources.history_note: One row per ticker holding only the next confirmed report date; there is no history of past dates here — past prints are the 8-K 2.02 and 6-K filings themselves. first_row_at and last_row_at are the earliest and latest scheduled dates currently held.
limits: Only dates the source marks as confirmed are served; its estimates are held internally and never served, and no date is ever computed on our side.
Major tickers only.
Dates only: the source does not encode before-open or after-close timing.

sources.cadence: The committed seed is synced into the database daily at 04:50 UTC; the seed itself is regenerated from the agencies' schedule pages and checked against them before it is committed.
sources.history_note: Occurrences from July 2026 onward: the first seed covers the second half of 2026 (releases 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31). There is no earlier history; later years appear as their seed files are committed.
limits: US releases only, ten series: FOMC decisions and minutes, CPI, PPI, nonfarm payrolls, GDP, PCE, advance retail sales, weekly jobless claims and JOLTS. ISM and Conference Board releases are deliberately absent.
Dates come from the agencies' own schedule pages; jobless-claims Thursdays and FOMC minutes are inferred from cadence until the agency publishes them (schedule_basis says which).
phase says whether the scheduled moment has passed, not that the agency actually published; released_at is not populated.
